narrationTexts: Confirmed shape. Now migrate each file's three call sites.
Verify no stray `db.query` remains outside the vendor file.
finalText:
**Migration done.** Moved 12 files off `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

| Package | Files |
|---|---|
| support | `sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js` |
| billing | `couponService.js`, `refund.js` |
| analytics | `cohort.js` |
| catalog | `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js` |
| accounts | `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `session.js` |
| orders | `returnService.js`, `shipment.js` |

One holdout left on purpose: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) still calls `db.query`, but it's a vendored file marked "do not edit, replaced wholesale on upgrade."

Next: decide if `adapter.js` needs a wrapper shim instead, since it can't be edited directly.
